title: Fireblocking.
officialText:
Where the combustible exterior wall covering is furred from the wall and forms a solid surface, the
distance between the back of the covering and the wall shall not exceed 15/ inches (41 mm). Where required by Section 717, the
8
space thereby created shall be fireblocked.
